text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Daily necessities... I think that's 
everything.)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
And this year is a super blowout special! 
First prize is a pair of tickets for a 
"Luxury Bus Tour"~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little lady! Done with your 
shopping? Got a lottery ticket? Feel free 
to come give it a spin~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Well... it's better than taking it home 
and throwing it away—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-rattle! ...Clink)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Congratulations, first prize!! You've 
won the 'Luxury Bus Tour'!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: So, here you go.
choice_data_list: No, no, no!? You're the one who won it...!
No, no, no!? You're the one who won it...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. I'm not really one for traveling.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I had it shoved into my hands 
anyway... As I looked over the tour's 
contents, something suddenly caught my 
attention.
choice_data_list:
It's called the "Good Old Historic 
Buildings Tour"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—along with Believe, I was set to 
embark on a luxury bus tour.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First we head to the destination via the 
highway, and after that, there's 
apparently a sightseeing tour."

text_block_list.name: Tour Conductor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for traveling all this way, 
everyone! We'll be taking a 15-minute 
break here~. Please relax and take your 
time.
choice_data_list: Shall we go stretch our legs for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I get off the bus at a rest stop to 
stretch out and relax. While I'm at it, I 
take a peek into the souvenir shop—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking the break was almost over, as I 
started back toward the bus... a 
heartwarming scene caught my eye.
choice_data_list: There's a dog park over there.
There's a dog park over there, huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? That gate... looks a little 
rickety—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *CRASH!*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Woof! Woof woof!" "Eek~!? Wait, wait! 
Don't go out thereーーー!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go after them!
choice_data_list: B-Be careful!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I warned her because of the heavy traffic 
nearby, but it seemed my worries were 
unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The average running speed of a large dog 
is about 40 km/h. In comparison, an 
Umamusume averages over 60 km/h. On top of 
that, Believe is... a sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof... !?

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, thank you so much...! I never 
expected the dog run gate to break 
suddenly like that... You really saved me!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Um, if it's all right, is there any way I 
can thank you!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. I have to get back to the bus soon―

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Hm? ...Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Prompted by Believe's wide-eyed reaction, 
I looked around the parking lot and 
gasped."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tour bus we rode in on... is nowhere 
to be seen!!
choice_data_list:
I-I got left behind because of a roll call 
mistake...?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like it. Being late for the 
meetup probably didn't help either.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!? I-I'm so, so sorry! Um, then 
let me pay for the taxi fare...!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys! —Y'all sure are makin' a 
big fuss. Did somethin' happen?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, so you got left behind! Poor thing~. 
It's fine, hop on in! We've got plenty of 
room.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm headin' to Tokyo, see. Sorry for 
surroundin' ya with nothin' but old folks.
choice_data_list: No, not at all, I'm truly grateful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To think a passing tour bus would let me 
hop on... Even though I had to give up on 
my trip, it was truly a dream come true."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Believe-chan is running in a race, 
huh. Brings back memories~ I used to go to 
Kokura all the time in the past too, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I see. So Kokura Racecourse is a nice 
place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, it's a great place~! It was so 
much fun. If you ever get the chance to 
go, Believe-chan, you should check out all 
kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do that. ...Um, by the way.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Is the AC too strong? Shall I adjust the 
airflow so it isn't blowing right at you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman B
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are ya sure? Thank ya kindly~!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man B
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-chan, I got chocolate, have some! 
I'm a sucker for sweets, ya see, so I 
always buy these huge bags!"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man B
text_block_list.text:
Umm, hold on a sec. ...Ngh... Nnnngh...!! 
Ah, darn it, my hands are shakin'â

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll open it. May I borrow it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the chocolates. May I 
open one of yours as well?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Singing... Is any song fine? Umm—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"O'er the fields of golden blossoms, the 
setting sun gently fades..."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: My, my~ What a lovely voice...!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm... What a lovely voice, and what a 
good girl.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan is soooo great...!"
choice_data_list: (She became an idol just like that...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by thoroughly relaxed seniors, 
Believe's expression seemed somewhat 
softer too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment I wondered how things would 
turn out, but... somehow, we ended up 
having a really nice time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, parting ways with the reluctant 
tour guests, we returned to the academy... 
back to our usual everyday lives.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's certainly turned into quite an 
unusual New Year, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: It was such a lively, fun day!
It was such a lively, fun day, wasn't it!
That song was amazing!
That song was really great!
Let's go touring buildings again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's certainly turned into quite an 
unusual New Year, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: It was such a lively, fun day!
It was such a lively, fun day, wasn't it!
That song was amazing!
That song was really great!
Let's go touring buildings again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I want them to stay well. For as 
long... as possible."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, thank you very much. Even though 
they were mostly old songs..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...I remember now. Singing with 
Grandma...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, that was my goal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I missed it this time... 
so, another day.
